paper_title: Upper limit on the axion-photon coupling from magnetic white dwarf polarization
notes: Main result from abstract: |g_aγγ| ≲ 5.4 × 10^-12 GeV^-1 at 95% confidence for m_a ≲ 3 × 10^-1 eV. The limit is derived from linear polarization observations of SDSS J135141 and Grw+70°8247 magnetic white dwarfs. The limit is approximately flat over the mass range from ~10^-7 eV to 0.3 eV, with physics supporting mass-independent constraints in this region. At very low masses (m_a < 10^-7 eV), the constraint weakens due to reduced polarization signal (proportional to m_a^-4). Confidence level extracted from abstract statement '95% confidence'.
